*Surcharges:
- Children from 0 to 1 year old stay for free if using existing bed.
- Surcharge for children 2-11 years old if using existing bed will be VND 500,000 per child per night.
- Surcharge for children 2-11 years old with an extra bed will be VND 1,400,000 – 1,850,000 per child per night.
- Surcharge for 3rd adult aged 12 and above with/without an extra bed will be VND 2,300,000 per pax per night.
- All Extra beds and Baby cots are subject to availability.

* Transportation:
- Complimentary shuttle buses from Ho Chi Minh City to Melia Ho Tram are available. Seats are subject to availability. Advance reservation is required (first come first served)
+ Route HCM – Melia: bus departs daily at 14:00, 19:00.
+ Route Melia – HCM: bus departs at daily 11:00, 14:00.
+ Pick up point: Ba La Tra Milk Tea Shop - Sarimi Building - Block A2 - 00.09, D09 Street, Sala City, An Loi Dong Ward, District 2, Thu Duc City.

* General Regulations:
- Guests are required to show a photo identification upon check-in:
+ Non-Vietnamese guests are required to present their valid passport with a valid visa or Temporary Resident Card.
+ Vietnamese guests are required to present valid national identification card or passport.
- The Level Pool is only applicable for guests aged 12 and above.
- Please present the same credit card used to guarantee your booking upon check-in if you selected the “pay to hotel” payment method.
- The Level Pool is only applicable for guests aged 12 and above.
- Pets are allowed on request at limited designated pet-friendly Villas only. Additional charges will be applicable for cleaning service. If you are planning to stay with your pet, please inform the resort in advance for arrangement.
- Gambling, contraband, prostitution, weapon, explosive, flammable, poison, drug items and strong smell food (i.e durian, seafood, etc…) are strictly prohibited within the hotel premises.

description.long:
Experience Luxury and Tranquility at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort

Nestled just 100 kilometers from the vibrant city center of Vung Tau, the Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort offers a perfect escape into a world of serenity and elegance. Built in 2019, this modern oasis boasts 298 beautifully appointed rooms that blend contemporary design with ultimate comfort, ensuring a memorable stay for every guest. Whether you're seeking relaxation on pristine beaches or exploring nearby attractions, the resort provides a seamless retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life. Conveniently located approximately 150 minutes from the airport, Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort is ideal for travelers seeking both accessibility and exclusivity. The hotel maintains a sophisticated atmosphere with check-in available from 4:00 PM and check-out until 12:00 PM, giving guests ample time to unwind and enjoy their surroundings. Please note that the resort's child policy does not include free stays for children, and additional charges may apply, making it a perfect destination for couples or adult travelers looking for a luxurious getaway.

Exceptional Entertainment and Relaxation Facilities at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort

Discover a world of leisure and entertainment at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort, where every guest's desire for relaxation and fun is catered to with a variety of exceptional facilities. Unwind after a day of exploration with a soothing massage or indulge in the rejuvenating warmth of the hot tub, sauna, and steam room, all designed to refresh your mind and body. For those seeking tranquility, the lush garden and inviting solarium provide perfect spots to relax and soak up the sun amidst lush greenery. For entertainment and convenience, the resort features an array of shops and a gift/souvenir shop, allowing guests to browse unique local items and souvenirs. When night falls, enjoy the vibrant atmosphere at the resort’s stylish bar and nightclub, where you can sip cocktails, dance, and socialize in a lively setting. Whether you’re looking to unwind in serenity or enjoy lively entertainment, Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort offers a comprehensive selection of facilities to ensure a memorable stay.

Unmatched Sports and Recreation Facilities at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort

Discover a haven for active travelers at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort, where a comprehensive range of sports facilities awaits. Stay energized and maintain your fitness routine with access to the resort’s state-of-the-art 24-hour fitness center and a free fitness center, allowing you to work out at your convenience amidst modern equipment. For those seeking relaxation and leisure, the outdoor pool offers a refreshing escape, complemented by a stylish poolside bar perfect for unwinding with a drink in hand. Step outside to enjoy the resort’s pristine private beach, where you can indulge in sunbathing, beach volleyball, or simply stroll along the sandy shores. Whether you’re looking to stay active or relax by the water, Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort provides an idyllic setting equipped with top-notch sports facilities to enhance your stay and create unforgettable memories.

Exceptional Convenience Facilities at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort

Experience seamless comfort and personalized service at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort, where every detail is designed for your convenience. Guests can enjoy the flexibility of 24-hour room service, ensuring delicious meals and refreshments are always at hand. For added ease, the resort offers efficient laundry and dry cleaning services, along with express check-in and check-out to make your arrival and departure smooth and hassle-free. Stay connected throughout your stay with complimentary Wi-Fi available in all rooms and public areas, including the executive lounge, perfect for business or leisure needs. Additional amenities such as luggage storage, daily housekeeping, and a dedicated concierge service further enhance your experience, providing assistance and ensuring your stay is comfortable and stress-free. Whether you're here for relaxation or business, Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort’s comprehensive convenience facilities are tailored to meet your every need, making your stay truly effortless and enjoyable.

Convenient Transport Facilities at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort

Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort offers a range of exceptional transport facilities designed to make your stay seamless and enjoyable. Guests can take advantage of the convenient airport transfer service, ensuring a smooth journey from the airport to the resort. For those eager to explore the surrounding area, the resort provides organized tours, allowing you to discover the beauty of Vung Tau with ease. Onsite, guests will find a spacious car park that is free of charge, offering hassle-free parking during your stay.

Luxurious Comfort and Modern Amenities at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort

Experience the ultimate in relaxation with our beautifully appointed rooms at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort, designed to offer both comfort and convenience. Each room features air conditioning to keep you cool, along with blackout curtains for restful sleep. Enjoy your favorite shows and movies on the satellite/cable TV, or unwind on the balcony or terrace while taking in stunning views. The rooms are equipped with a refrigerator, mini bar, and complimentary bottled water, ensuring your essentials are always at hand. For added convenience, a coffee/tea maker and complimentary instant coffee and tea are provided, perfect for a morning boost or an evening unwind.

Exquisite Dining Experience at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort

Indulge in a variety of culinary delights at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort, where our diverse dining facilities cater to every taste and preference. Start your day with a sumptuous breakfast buffet, featuring a wide array of international and local dishes to energize your morning. For a relaxed coffee break or a casual snack, visit our inviting coffee shop, perfect for unwinding with your favorite brew or light refreshments. In addition to our on-site restaurant offering a delectable menu of regional and international cuisines, guests can enjoy the convenience of 24-hour room service, ensuring that delicious meals and snacks are always just a call away. For those who love outdoor dining or special gatherings, our BBQ facilities provide an excellent setting to enjoy grilled specialties in a beautiful seaside atmosphere. Daily housekeeping ensures your comfort and cleanliness, making your stay at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort truly memorable.

Luxurious Room Options at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort

Discover a range of exquisite room types at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort, designed to cater to every traveler’s preference. From the cozy Deluxe Room Garden View and Deluxe Room Ocean View to the more spacious Junior Suite Ocean View, each room promises a comfortable and elegant stay. For families or groups seeking extra space, the Two Bedroom Family Suite Ocean View and Two Bedroom Suite Ocean View provide ample room and privacy. For those seeking ultimate luxury, the Level 1-Bedroom and Level 3-Bedroom Pool Villas, both lakefront and beachfront, offer expansive living areas with stunning views, perfect for a memorable getaway. Booking your stay through Agoda ensures you access the best prices available, along with a hassle-free booking experience. Enjoy peace of mind with our easy reservation process, quick confirmation, and exclusive deals that help you make the most of your stay at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort. Whether you're planning a romantic escape, a family vacation, or a luxurious retreat, Agoda makes it simple to find the perfect room to suit your needs.

Discover the Pristine Beauty of Ho Tram Beach in Vung Tau, Vietnam

Nestled along the southeastern coast of Vietnam, Ho Tram Beach is a tranquil paradise renowned for its unspoiled white sands and crystal-clear waters. This pristine shoreline offers a perfect escape from the bustling city life, inviting visitors to unwind and soak up the sun in a serene setting. The gentle waves and lush greenery surrounding the area create a picturesque backdrop, making it an ideal spot for relaxation, beach activities, or romantic strolls along the coast.

Seamless Journey from Nearby Airports to Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort

Traveling to the luxurious Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort is a breeze, whether you're arriving via Tan Son Nhat International Airport in Ho Chi Minh City or Vung Tau’s local airports. From Tan Son Nhat International Airport, located approximately 120 kilometers from the resort, guests can opt for a comfortable private transfer or a scenic drive by car. The journey typically takes around 2.5 to 3 hours, with well-maintained highways making the trip smooth and enjoyable. Many local transport services offer pre-arranged private shuttles or taxis that provide door-to-door service, ensuring a hassle-free start to your relaxing getaway. For those arriving closer to Vung Tau, the city’s small regional airport offers limited domestic flights, but most travelers prefer to arrive via Ho Chi Minh City and then continue their journey southward. Upon arrival, you can choose to rent a car, hire a private driver, or book a shared shuttle to Ho Tram Beach. The scenic drive along the coast offers stunning views of the South China Sea and lush landscapes, setting the perfect tone for your vacation. Whichever option you choose, the journey to Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort promises a comfortable and picturesque start to your unforgettable stay in Vietnam’s beautiful seaside retreat.

Discover the Nearby Attractions of Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort

Nestled along the pristine coastline, Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort offers easy access to some of the region's most captivating landmarks. Just a short distance away is Ho Tram Beach, renowned for its soft sands and tranquil waters, perfect for relaxing strolls or refreshing dips in the sea. Visitors can also explore the charming Quầy thuốc 172, a local pharmacy that provides a glimpse into everyday life in the area. For those interested in local culture and history, the Di tích Dốc Cây Cám offers a unique insight into the area's past. Nature enthusiasts and adventure seekers can venture to Khu du lịch Gió Biển, a scenic spot that combines natural beauty with recreational activities. Additionally, nearby agricultural supply points like Vật tư Nông nghiệp Chí Trang and Vật tư Nông nghiệp Chín Diệp highlight the region's farming heritage. Whether you're seeking relaxation, cultural exploration, or outdoor adventures, the surroundings of Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort provide an enriching and diverse experience.

A Culinary Journey Nearby Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort

Guests staying at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort have a delightful array of dining options just moments away. From the vibrant flavors of Ba Phi Seafood Restaurant and Khoi Seafood Restaurant, to the exquisite Vietnamese cuisine at Ginger Vietnam Cuisine and Lemongrass Ho Tram, every palate is catered to. For a beachside experience, Breeza Beach Club offers refreshing drinks and light bites with stunning ocean views. Seafood lovers can indulge at Lob Ho Tram Restaurant, while the Gecko Restaurant provides a cozy spot for casual dining. Additionally, local favorites like Phat Dat Bread and the charming Du An Farami add to the diverse culinary landscape, ensuring a memorable gastronomic adventure during your stay.

Nearby Shopping Landmarks

Just a short drive from Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort, guests can explore the vibrant Hamptons Plaza Ho Tram, a premier shopping destination offering a wide array of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment venues. Whether you're looking for fashionable apparel, unique souvenirs, or a relaxing place to unwind, Hamptons Plaza provides a convenient and enjoyable shopping experience. Its modern amenities and lively atmosphere make it an ideal spot for both leisure and family outings, enhancing your stay with a touch of local shopping culture.

Luxury Meets Affordability: Comparing Room Prices at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort and Vung Tau

Nestled along the pristine shores of Ho Tram, Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort offers an exceptional stay with room prices ranging from $101 to $150. This premium pricing reflects the resort's luxurious amenities, stunning ocean views, and world-class service, making it an ideal choice for travelers seeking a high-end getaway. While this price point positions Melia as a more upscale option, it promises an unforgettable experience that justifies the investment for those looking to indulge in comfort and elegance. In contrast, the average hotel room in Vung Tau typically costs between $51 and $75, making it a more budget-friendly destination for travelers. While the city offers a variety of accommodations that cater to different budgets, the higher price range at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort underscores its status as a premium resort destination. Visitors seeking a blend of luxury and scenic beauty will find that the slightly higher cost at Melia provides access to superior amenities, exclusive beachfront access, and a truly memorable stay in one of Vietnam’s most beautiful coastal areas.

Exceptional Hospitality and Stunning Comfort at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort

Guests consistently praise Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort for its warm and friendly staff, creating a welcoming and helpful atmosphere that enhances every stay. The attentive service and genuine hospitality make visitors feel valued and well cared for from the moment they arrive. The resort’s beautiful setting is complemented by its spotless cleanliness and well-maintained facilities, ensuring a relaxing and enjoyable environment. Many guests highlight the delicious cuisine, especially recommending the Breeze restaurant for its superb food offerings. The comfortable beds and overall high-quality amenities contribute to a superb experience, leaving visitors with fond memories and a strong desire to return. With its combination of excellent service, beautiful surroundings, and delectable dining options, Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort truly stands out as a top choice for a memorable getaway.

Exceptional Customer Praise for Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort

Guests consistently commend Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort for its outstanding overall experience, reflected in an impressive overall rating of 9.2. The resort’s top-tier facilities and meticulous cleanliness—rated at 9.3 and 9.5 respectively—create a luxurious and hygienic environment that elevates every stay. Visitors appreciate the seamless blend of modern amenities and thoughtful design, making it a perfect retreat for relaxation and comfort. Furthermore, the dedicated staff at Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort receive high praise for their exceptional service, earning a remarkable performance rating of 9.4. While the location is valued for its tranquil setting, guests find the overall value offered by the resort to be excellent, with a rating of 9.0. This combination of superior facilities, pristine cleanliness, attentive staff, and a serene environment makes Melia Ho Tram Beach Resort a highly recommended destination for travelers seeking a memorable and indulgent escape.
